svg.title: Per-system upgrade cycle (BPMN 2.0) - used for XS4, DS4, QS4, SS4, PS4, DS5, QS5

text.tspan: Per-system upgrade cycle - runs for XS4, DS4, QS4, SS4, PS4, DS5, QS5 (first system = DS4 for SPDD / SPAU adjustments)
GTS, AFC, MBC, DRC, Work Zone,
1. ECS triggers SUM about 24 h before the downtime start in the SR (UG 5); XS4 preparation started 36 h before. SNOTE is blocked while SUM runs (message TN687), so notes must be in before C3.
2. SPDD / SPAU in DS4 only; QS4, SS4, PS4, DS5, QS5 reuse the released DS4 transports in phase ADJUSTPRP (UG 3.5). The SR form asks for the transport IDs (<SID>K9xxxxx).
3. Fiori follow-ups (C10) are not part of the ECS standard subscription (UG 6.3): INTL Basis performs them unless ECS CAS (BASIC_1.5.03) is bought - decision D-O4.
4. SDMIs run in uptime by default; forcing them into downtime must be written into the SR (UG 6.1) - decision D-O1.
